title: Share Live Location During Rides
description: Always share your trip status and live location with trusted family members or friends when using cabs or public transport.

title: Verify Vehicle and Driver Details
description: Check that the car model, license plate number, and driver match the details displayed in your ride-hailing app before getting in.

title: Enable Two-Factor Authentication (2FA)
description: Secure all your social media, email, and banking accounts with two-factor authentication to protect against unauthorized access.

title: Be Cautious with Personal Information Online
description: Avoid sharing real-time locations, home address, or travel itineraries on public social media channels.

title: Set Up Emergency Speed Dial & SOS Shortcuts
description: Configure emergency contacts and hardware SOS triggers (e.g., pressing power button multiple times) on your smartphone.

title: Keep Emergency Helplines Accessible
description: Save national emergency helplines such as 112 (Emergency) and 181 (Women Helpline) in your contacts list.

title: Stay Aware of Surroundings in Public
description: Avoid using high-volume headphones or becoming distracted by screens while walking in poorly lit or unfamiliar areas.

title: Trust Your Instincts and Seek Safe Spaces
description: If you feel uncomfortable or followed, enter a well-lit shop, restaurant, or public building immediately and seek assistance.

title: Carry Basic Personal Safety Tools
description: Keep a loud safety whistle, personal safety alarm, or pepper spray easily accessible in your bag or pocket when out.
